Name: Invisi-Rocks
Author: Doragoun
Description:
This mod makes all ordinary rocks in the mines invisible so you can stare at the floor in peace without being bothered by pesky non-ore and non-gem rocks. It also removes shadows from rocks (and a lot more things) because otherwise, something would block it. We can't have that, can we? Enjoy!

[Spoiler]Happy April Fools' Day. :)[/Spoiler]
